details: US jobless claims fell to 215,000 last week, indicating a stable but slower hiring environment. However, the Federal Reserve's June FOMC minutes revealed a hawkish bias, with several officials projecting further rate hikes in 2026. Inflation concerns are fueled by the ongoing US-Iran conflict and AI-driven demand for energy, pointing to a "higher-for-longer" interest rate environment for risk assets.
title: US Jobless Claims Dip, Fed Signals Hawkish Stance Amid Inflation Fears

details: The European Central Bank (ECB) is reassessing its inflation fight due to renewed US-Iran hostilities pushing energy prices higher. An ECB policymaker stated they are "back to square one," indicating that further rate hikes are anticipated, despite earlier easing of pressure for a July hike. The ECB had already raised rates in June and anticipates more tightening over the next year to contain inflation fallout.
title: ECB "Back to Square One" on Inflation as US-Iran War Resumes, Rate Hikes Expected

details: Following a challenging June that saw approximately $4.5 billion in net outflows from US spot Bitcoin ETFs, institutional capital flows into Bitcoin have turned net positive. This rebound suggests a stabilization and recovery in Bitcoin, which is currently consolidating in the $62,000–$62,800 range, with easing selling pressure from ETFs and shifting macroeconomic conditions.
title: Institutional Bitcoin Flows Rebound After $4.5B ETF Outflows

details: Circle, the issuer of the USDC stablecoin, has secured final regulatory approval from the U.S. Office of the Comptroller of the Currency (OCC) to establish a national trust bank. This landmark approval places Circle National Trust under federal oversight, bolstering USDC's regulatory standing and infrastructure, with future plans for reserve management.
title: Circle Gets OCC Approval for National Trust Bank, Strengthening USDC

details: Temasek Holdings, Singapore's state investment fund, has opted against direct cryptocurrency investments, citing regulatory uncertainty and a previous $275 million loss from the FTX collapse. The fund will instead reallocate capital towards artificial intelligence (AI), aiming for 15% of its portfolio in AI-related holdings by 2031, up from 6% in Q1 2026.
title: Singapore's Temasek Rules Out Direct Crypto Investments, Prioritizes AI

details: China maintained mild consumer price index (CPI) growth of 1% year-on-year in the first half of 2026, with June seeing a slight monthly dip due to seasonal factors and international price volatility. The IMF upgraded China's 2026 growth forecast by 0.2 percentage points to 4.6%, attributing it to robust high-tech manufacturing and strong export growth, particularly driven by AI demand, amidst a downgraded global growth outlook.
title: China's H1 Prices Stable; IMF Upgrades Growth on Tech/Exports
